name: field::sample / FieldFrame

test_list.description: The same (seed, t, u, v) always yields a bit-identical Sample.
Two seeds place stars on different lattice cells.
For t in [0,600] and u,v in [0,1] luminance and star are finite and within 0..=1 and every tint channel is finite within 0..=1.
Luminance and star are exactly 0 on all four borders of the frame and the edge mask is 1 in the interior.
At t=0 the mean luminance on the animated S-curve ribbon is far larger than the mean luminance of points offset 0.2 away from it.
The fraction of star cells is inside (0.002, 0.02), twinkle opacity stays in 0.38..=0.88 and star colours come only from the star palette.
Luminance changes by less than 0.03 everywhere between t and t+1/30 s (no per-frame flicker).
The sampled tint is always a convex mix of the demo sage palette stops (within the per-channel palette bounds times the tint gain).

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Seeds the star lattice, texture jitter, noise lattice and tint phase.

output_description: Luminance 0..=1 (already edge-masked), a sage tint (rgb 0..=1) and a star twinkle opacity (0 when the lattice cell is not a star).
